claim: The pilot is confirmed for the week beginning 9 November 2026. The week beginning 21 September will remain recorded only as the original date, discarded because of the mapping and licensing delay.
evidence: Third SILEX steering committee meeting to review validation results and confirm the final municipal pilot date. The week beginning 9 November 2026 is approved as the new date, replacing the discarded original September date.
All 62 procedures have been validated. Mandatory-field coverage is 98.4 percent, and no critical errors remain. There are five minor warnings related to descriptive text.
The suspended-deadline and temporal-name rules work as agreed. The version 1.1 candidate can be approved.
The acceptance criteria agreed with the municipality are met at this stage.
Santa Marina confirms staff and room availability during the week beginning 9 November. We need to receive the stable environment by 26 October.
We can therefore convert the provisional date into the final date.
